method: rating-dependent perception states plus MultiPV softmax

validation.note: high variance; previous 60-game samples of deterministic one-thread play were near 2780

guardrails: Mate-in-one recognition probability rises with rating.
Avoiding an opponent mate in one is probabilistic below expert ratings.
notes: Beginner ratings are chained through adjacent profiles because Stockfish UCI_Elo bottoms out near 1320.
Short stochastic matches have at least roughly 100 Elo uncertainty.
Ratings can shift across clocks, hardware, and opponent pools.
